propositions: The import-linter job in _optionality.yml consumes one concurrent job slot while providing redundant test coverage already delivered by the matrix cells in _build-and-test.yml

Deletion of the import-linter job creates a gap: no checked-in guard ensures tests/unit/test_core_optionality.py and tests/unit/test_optional.py remain collected under default pytest selection, risking future contributors from accidentally excluding them via markers or file moves
A durable collection-based test asserting 9 items are collected from the two files under -m 'not integration and not external' selection can replace the deleted job's implicit optionality guard
The collection guard must be verified by running real pytest selection, not by grepping marker text, so it catches markers added at any scope
